verdict.rationale: Bevy is fully open-source under MIT/Apache 2.0 with no restrictions, explicitly framed around developer ownership of tools and full source visibility, and this is corroborated by community sentiment praising the permissive license and readable, elegant source code. Users can inspect and modify the actual engine source (it's a normal Rust dependency/crate), not just extend via plugins. Missing for 10: no independent evidence of developers actually patching/forking core engine internals in production to fix a blocker, only license and code-quality corroboration.
